item.title: Hip Involvement Signals Severe Axial Spondyloarthritis
item.description: In outpatient axial spondyloarthritis care, radiographic hip involvement affected 13.90% and aligned with greater severity overall. The post Hip Involvement Signals Severe Axial Spondyloarthritis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Large Language Models in Glaucoma Need Guardrails
item.description: Large language models in glaucoma show promise for education and decision support, yet performance varies widely. The post Large Language Models in Glaucoma Need Guardrails appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Multicomponent Vaccine Shows Promise Against Flu and COVID-19
item.description: A single-dose multicomponent mRNA vaccine elicits durable immune responses against influenza and COVID-19 in a Phase 1/2 trial. The post Multicomponent Vaccine Shows Promise Against Flu and COVID-19 appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Metastatic Breast Cancer Shows Biomarker Differences
item.description: Metastatic ILC shows significant biomarker heterogeneity, limiting single biopsy reliability and highlighting challenges in detection and monitoring. The post Metastatic Breast Cancer Shows Biomarker Differences appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Childhood Interstitial Lung Disease and Quality of Life
item.description: A European study finds hospitalisations and insufficient growth reduce health-related quality of life in childhood interstitial lung disease. The post Childhood Interstitial Lung Disease and Quality of Life appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cannabis Use Associated with Worse Working Memory
item.description: Heavy cannabis use linked to reduced brain activation during memory tasks, raising concerns about lasting cognitive health effects. The post Cannabis Use Associated with Worse Working Memory appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Bimekizumab Sustains 3-Year Benefits in Psoriasis
item.description: Three-year BE RADIANT results highlight durable bimekizumab benefits in plaque psoriasis, improving PROs and QoL. Read more. The post Bimekizumab Sustains 3-Year Benefits in Psoriasis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: DMT Rapidly Reduces Major Depression Symptoms
item.description: DMT therapy significantly reduced major depressive disorder symptoms in a phase IIa trial. Learn more about this rapid-acting psychedelic approach. The post DMT Rapidly Reduces Major Depression Symptoms appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Two-Thirds of Women Stop Taking Antidepressants During Pregnancy
item.description: Nearly two-thirds of women stop taking prescribed antidepressants during pregnancy, a 2026 cross-sectional analysis has found. The post Two-Thirds of Women Stop Taking Antidepressants During Pregnancy appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Gilead to acquire CAR-T biotech Arcellx for $7.8bn
item.description: The deal is a unified effort to advance a CAR T-cell therapy currently under regulatory review for multiple myeloma. The post Gilead to acquire CAR-T biotech Arcellx for $7.8bn appeared first on European Medical Journal.
